artifact_observations.location: Text blocks on the left-hand pages
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text simulating descriptions under the bird illustrations is largely illegible gibberish. Characters are malformed, spacing is inconsistent, and words do not form coherent language, which is a common AI artifact when rendering dense text.
The edges of the paper sheets near the rings appear slightly soft and fused rather than crisp individual sheets. There is minor ambiguity in how the holes align perfectly with the rings.
The curvature of the left pages near the spine is slightly unnatural, appearing somewhat flattened or inconsistently warped compared to the physical tension expected from a ring binder.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a binder/ring-binder and not just a stack of papers or a book.
To rigorously analyze the legibility and structural integrity of the text blocks, which show signs of gibberish.
To verify the topological connection between the paper holes and the metal rings, ensuring no floating elements or fusion errors.
To assess general coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle blending artifacts between the illustrations and the paper texture.

focus_areas: Legibility and character structure of the text on the pages
Physical plausibility of the ring mechanism engaging with paper holes
Edge sharpness and separation of individual paper sheets
Consistency of lighting and shadows across the open binder
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text quality. AI often fails at rendering small, dense text, resulting in 'fake' writing that looks like text from a distance but is gibberish up close. Verify if the ring mechanism physically makes sense (do the rings actually go through the holes?).
